passages.text: Now after the death of His servant Moses, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying, “Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Moses served the LORD.
Moses died.
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Joshua assisted Moses.
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD said, “Moses, My servant, is dead.
Now get up.
You must cross the Jordan River.
Take all these people with you.
Go into the land.
I am giving this land to the children of Israel.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֛י מ֥וֹת מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֔וּן מְשָׁרֵ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדִּ֖י מֵ֑ת וְעַתָּה֩ ק֨וּם עֲבֹ֜ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַזֶּ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua, the son of Nun.
Joshua was Moses’ assistant.
God said, “I have given you every place you will walk on.
Wherever you set your foot, that place belongs to you.
I promised this to Moses.
I am keeping my promise to you.”
passages.original: כָּל־ מָק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף־ רַגְלְכֶ֛ם בּ֖וֹ לָכֶ֣ם נְתַתִּ֑יו כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and west as far as the Great Sea.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua, the son of Nun.
Joshua was Moses’ assistant.
God told Joshua about the land for Israel.
God said, “Your territory will be large.”
It will start at the wilderness.
It will include Lebanon.
It will reach to the great River Euphrates.
It will cover all the land of the Hittites.
It will go west to the Great Sea.
The Great Sea is where the sun sets.
This will be your border.
passages.original: מֵהַמִּדְבָּר֩ וְהַלְּבָנ֨וֹן הַזֶּ֜ה וְֽעַד־ הַנָּהָ֧ר הַגָּד֣וֹל נְהַר־ פְּרָ֗ת כֹּ֚ל אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחִתִּ֔ים וְעַד־ הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל מְב֣וֹא הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶ֖ה גְּבוּלְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: No one shall stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so will I be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua.
God chose Joshua to lead Israel after Moses.
God promised Joshua His presence and help.
No one will be able to stand against you.
This will be true all the days of your life.
I was with Moses.
I will be with you in the same way.
I will not leave you.
I will not abandon you.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיִ֤יתִי עִם־ מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א אַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֶֽךָּ׃

passages.text: Be strong and courageous, for you shall give these people the inheritance of the land that I swore to their fathers I would give them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua.
God chose Joshua to lead Israel.
God told Joshua to be strong.
God told Joshua to be courageous.
God said Joshua would give the Israelites their land.
God promised this land to the ancestors of the Israelites.
God swore to give this land to them.
Joshua would help the people receive this promise.
passages.original: חֲזַ֖ק וֶאֱמָ֑ץ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תַּנְחִיל֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶת־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Above all, be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may prosper wherever you go.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua.
God told Joshua to be strong.
God told Joshua to be very courageous.
God commanded Joshua to obey the law.
Moses, God’s servant, gave this law to Joshua.
Joshua must keep all the law.
Joshua must not turn from the law.
Joshua must not turn to the right.
Joshua must not turn to the left.
If Joshua obeys, he will prosper.
Joshua will prosper wherever he goes.
passages.original: רַק֩ חֲזַ֨ק וֶֽאֱמַ֜ץ מְאֹ֗ד לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ כְּכָל־ הַתּוֹרָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוְּךָ֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֔י אַל־ תָּס֥וּר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֔יל בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua, the new leader of Israel.
God gave Joshua clear instructions.
Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips.
Speak about it often.
Think about it day and night.
Do this so you will obey everything written in it.
Follow all its commands.
If you do this, you will prosper in your way.
You will have success in all you do.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יָמ֡וּשׁ סֵפֶר֩ הַתּוֹרָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה מִפִּ֗יךָ וְהָגִ֤יתָ בּוֹ֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה לְמַ֙עַן֙ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּכָל־ הַכָּת֖וּב בּ֑וֹ כִּי־ אָ֛ז תַּצְלִ֥יחַ אֶת־ דְּרָכֶ֖ךָ וְאָ֥ז תַּשְׂכִּֽיל׃

passages.text: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua.
God gave Joshua a command.
God said, “Be strong.
Be courageous.
Do not be afraid.
Do not be discouraged.
The LORD your God is with you.
God will be with you wherever you go.”
passages.original: הֲל֤וֹא צִוִּיתִ֙יךָ֙ חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָ֔ץ אַֽל־ תַּעֲרֹ֖ץ וְאַל־ תֵּחָ֑ת כִּ֤י עִמְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃פ

passages.text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people: “Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Prepare your provisions, for within three days you will cross the Jordan to go in and take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
Joshua spoke to the officers of the people.
He gave them a command.
He said, “Go through the camp.
Tell the people this message.
Prepare your provisions.
In three days, you will cross the Jordan River.
You will enter the land.
The LORD your God is giving you this land.
You will take possession of it.”
passages.original: וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אֶת־ שֹׁטְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃ עִבְר֣וּ׀ בְּקֶ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה וְצַוּ֤וּ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָכִ֥ינוּ לָכֶ֖ם צֵידָ֑ה כִּ֞י בְּע֣וֹד׀ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים אַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִים֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה לָבוֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said, “Remember what Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you when he said, ‘The LORD your God will give you rest, and He will give you this land.’
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses died.
Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Joshua said to them, “Remember what Moses commanded you.
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
Moses told you, ‘The LORD your God will give you rest.
The LORD your God will give you this land.’”
passages.original: וְלָרֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְלַגָּדִ֔י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃ זָכוֹר֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ מֵנִ֣יחַ לָכֶ֔ם וְנָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: Your wives, your young children, and your livestock may remain in the land that Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan. But all your mighty men of valor must be armed for battle to cross over ahead of your brothers and help them, until the LORD gives them rest as He has done for you, and your brothers also possess the land that the LORD your God is giving them. Then you may return to the land of your inheritance and take possession of that which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the east side of the Jordan.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Your wives may stay in the land.
Your young children may stay in the land.
Your livestock may stay in the land.
Moses gave you this land on the east side of the Jordan.
All your strong warriors must get ready for battle.
You must cross the Jordan ahead of your fellow Israelites.
You must help your brothers.
You must do this until the LORD gives your brothers rest, just as He gave you rest.
You must do this until your brothers also take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving them.
After that, you may return to your own land.
You may take possession of your inheritance.
Moses, the servant of the LORD, gave you this land on the east side of the Jordan, toward the sunrise.
passages.original: נְשֵׁיכֶ֣ם טַפְּכֶם֮ וּמִקְנֵיכֶם֒ יֵשְׁב֕וּ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְאַתֶּם֩ תַּעַבְר֨וּ חֲמֻשִׁ֜ים לִפְנֵ֣י אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ל גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֔יִל וַעֲזַרְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃ עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר־ יָנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֥ה׀ לַֽאֲחֵיכֶם֮ כָּכֶם֒ וְיָרְשׁ֣וּ גַם־ הֵ֔מָּה אֶת־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם וְשַׁבְתֶּ֞ם לְאֶ֤רֶץ יְרֻשַּׁתְכֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֗ם מֹשֶׁה֙ עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֔ה בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרַ֥ח הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

passages.text: So they answered Joshua, “Everything you have commanded us we will do, and everywhere you send us we will go.
passages.sermon:
The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh spoke to Joshua.
They answered Joshua directly.
They said, “We will do everything you have commanded us.
We will go everywhere you send us.”
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲנ֔וּ אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוִּיתָ֙נוּ֙ נַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְאֶֽל־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֖נוּ נֵלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: Just as we obeyed Moses in all things, so we will obey you. And may the LORD your God be with you, as He was with Moses.
passages.sermon:
The people spoke to Joshua.
They said, “We obeyed Moses in everything.
We will obey you in the same way.
We ask that the LORD your God will be with you.
We want God to be with you as He was with Moses.”
passages.original: כְּכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֖ן נִשְׁמַ֣ע אֵלֶ֑יךָ רַ֠ק יִֽהְיֶ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Anyone who rebels against your order and does not obey your words, all that you command him, will be put to death. Above all, be strong and courageous!”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
\r\nThe people spoke to Joshua.
\r\nThey said, “Any person who disobeys your command will be put to death.
\r\nAny person who does not listen to your words will be put to death.
\r\nThis applies to everything you command.
\r\nBut you must be strong.
\r\nYou must be courageous.”
passages.original: כָּל־ אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יַמְרֶ֣ה אֶת־ פִּ֗יךָ וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׁמַ֧ע אֶת־ דְּבָרֶ֛יךָ לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ תְּצַוֶּ֖נּוּ יוּמָ֑ת רַ֖ק חֲזַ֥ק וֶאֱמָֽץ׃פ
